title: argyreia sphaerocephala
intro: Argyreia sphaerocephala, commonly known as the moon vine or wolf's milk, is a plant species in the Convolvulaceae family. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as an adaptogen, which helps the body to adapt to stress, and as a galactagogue, which increases milk production in lactating women. The therapeutic actions of Argyreia sphaerocephala include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties, which can help to relieve anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include steroidal saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
